title: Never add a deploy step or a Cloudflare token to GitHub Actions; Pages builds the repo on its own
body: GitHub Actions only runs gates (content-validation.yml, version-gate.yml, flujo-de-ramas.yml, smoke-deploy.yml). It does not deploy: Cloudflare Pages pulls and builds `staging` and `main` itself. Consequence, and the reason to keep it this way: there is no Cloudflare token stored in GitHub, so nothing to rotate if a workflow log leaks. Earlier the site was built in Actions and the finished `dist/` uploaded to Pages; that was dropped once the build stopped needing Chromium. If a workflow seems to need Cloudflare API access, find another way (e.g. the smoke reads public URLs and /build.json) rather than adding a secret.
not_derivable: The absence of a token is a deliberate security choice; code cannot show why something is missing.

evidence.summary: Verifies the published site using only public URLs and /build.json.
